# MoldStud

> > Custom software development company specializing in .NET, Java, C#, and enterprise solutions with a focus on accessible, secure, and scalable applications.

MoldStud provides technical guides, tutorials, and consulting services led by Vasile Crudu and team. The site covers full-stack development, IoT solutions, enterprise consulting, and modern frameworks including Spring Boot, React, and ASP.NET MVC.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- .NET Framework & C#
- Java & Spring Boot
- Full-Stack Development
- Enterprise IoT & Industry 4.0
- API Development & Documentation
- Security (AES-256, TLS, OAuth 2.0)
- Mobile App Development
- Performance Optimization
- WCAG Accessibility Compliance
- Visual Studio & Development Tools
- Docker & Kubernetes
- React & Node.js
- ASP.NET MVC
- DevOps & CI/CD
